name: Dark Streetwear
summary: A fashion aesthetic combining dark color palettes with streetwear silhouettes, emphasizing black, charcoal, and muted tones.
description: Dark Streetwear is a fashion aesthetic that merges the comfort and silhouettes of streetwear with a predominantly dark color palette. Characterized by black, charcoal, navy, and muted earth tones, it often features oversized fits, technical fabrics, and minimalist branding. The aesthetic draws from goth, techwear, and minimalist influences while maintaining the casual functionality of streetwear.
